storage: workspace-scoped canonical feature-key postings; optional numeric coordinate snapshots are derived

templates.meaning: Preserves the argument role and the exact typed value.
Keeps all argument bindings and polarity together.
Omits only the declared value roles and polarity; candidate grouping, never a conflict verdict.
Inspectability and partial matching; path follows canonical child ordering.
Tracks transfer conditions separately from the asserted condition.
Repository/time semantics; authority filtering still applies separately.
Role of a concept within a procedure; does not encode execution ordering by itself.

dictionary_rules: Canonical keys are typed JSON tuples; never delimiter-concatenated strings.
Initial publication sorts canonical UTF-8 keys; subsequent publication appends new IDs without reassigning old IDs.
Every numerical vector names an immutable dictionary snapshot. Comparisons across snapshots require an explicit mapping.
Unknown keys remain in canonical postings until a new snapshot is published; they are not folded into one OTHER coordinate.
Private keys stay within the existing workspace/visibility boundary; deletion removes source-derived private keys when retention permits.

scoring.note: Equal weights are an initial evaluation baseline, not an established optimum. Empty union returns no_score; scope/authorization/applicability are checked separately. Conflict search uses conflict_slot and role keys then runs the diagnostic classifier.

dense_spaces: Keep base encoder spaces independent. Learned projections declare all input-space IDs, vocabulary/dictionary revisions, feature selector, weights, training manifest, dimensions, metric and normalization.
learned_head_formula: z_p = normalize(g_p(base_embedding, selected_structured_features)); train the query and item paths under the same declared objective.
